shared_elements: bearded human figures in strict profile
procession/file of figures moving in one direction
long robes with regular pleat/fold lines
patterned or curled hair and headgear
register with base line along the bottom
justification: Both surfaces depict a continuous horizontal register of bearded, robed human figures in strict profile walking in one direction as a procession, rendered in shallow relief with the same conventions for stylised curled hair, headgear, and closely-spaced parallel drapery folds — a very specific shared scheme. The main difference in depicted content is that A includes large horned rams being led by the attendants (an animal-tribute group in the foreground), while B's frieze shows an unbroken file of human figures only, set below architectural elements (columns, stairway) absent from A.
